- Midway Games: Midway Games is headquartered in Chicago. Midway Games developed Mortal Kombat 3.
- Chris Claremont: Chris Claremont is famous for Uncanny X-Men and Blue Peter.
- Tim Sweeney: Epic Games was founded by Tim Sweeney, who is also the director of the company.
- Kojima Productions: The director of Kojima Productions is Hideo Kojima. Kojima Productions developed Unreal Tournament.

- Sony Interactive Entertainment: The headquarters of Sony Interactive Entertainment is located in Tokyo, San Jose, and was also stated to be in the city of Israel.
